# rtl-sdr corresponding source

These are the exact Debian source artifacts for `rtl-sdr` source version
`2.0.2-2`, corresponding to the arm64 binary packages bundled by WaveRider.
They were downloaded from Debian Sources and are redistributed without
modification. Verify them from this directory with:

```sh
sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS
```

Upstream package page: <https://sources.debian.org/src/rtl-sdr/2.0.2-2/>

The Debian `.dsc` also records the upstream and Debian archive checksums. Each
binary package retains its `/usr/share/doc/*/copyright` file when installed.

Bundled arm64 binary-package checksums (Debian binNMU `2.0.2-2+b1`, built from
this unchanged `2.0.2-2` source):

```text
4edd72c4f9a250a237a1d6d56a3120638d147560fd9e3d7e78a693b010bbb7f9  librtlsdr0_2.0.2-2+b1_arm64.deb
d139e07182836a94244285f441ba8355ff7e953a58f03090837d203426d48e3e  rtl-sdr_2.0.2-2+b1_arm64.deb
```
